## FileNodeOnExists is exhaustive though onExists has gained a value in each recent draft revision
Crates: jmap-filenode-client
Evidence: crate-jmap-filenode-client/src/methods/filenode.rs:64-84 `pub enum FileNodeOnExists { Replace, Rename, Newest, Unchanged }` has no #[non_exhaustive]. Across the drafts: draft-ietf-jmap-filenode-13 has neither "newest" nor "unchanged", -14 adds "newest", -16/-17 add "unchanged" (JMAP-CONDITIONAL). Every other wire enum in the workspace carries #[non_exhaustive].
Why breaking later: Adding a variant to an exhaustive public enum breaks downstream exhaustive matches. Given the growth across revisions, the next draft revision would force a major bump.
Fix: Add #[non_exhaustive] to FileNodeOnExists.

## Client input enums RsvpStatus and FileNodeOnExists are missing #[non_exhaustive]
Crates: jmap-chat-client, jmap-filenode-client
Evidence: crate-jmap-chat-client/src/calendars.rs:19 `pub enum RsvpStatus { Accepted, Declined, Tentative, Delegated }` has no #[non_exhaustive]. The crate states its own rule at crate-jmap-chat-client/src/methods/mod.rs:246: every enum in the crate carries #[non_exhaustive], and Patch<T> is the only stated exception. The values come from JSCalendar participationStatus (RFC 8984 §4.4.6), an IANA-registry-extensible set that also defines "needs-action"; jmap-jscalendar-types/src/lib.rs:714 keeps that field as an open String. crate-jmap-filenode-client/src/methods/filenode.rs:66 `pub enum FileNodeOnExists { Replace, Rename, Newest, Unchanged }` also has no #[non_exhaustive]. Its value set has already grown once across draft revisions: closed bead JMAP-4vf8.19 'FileNodeOnExists lacks newest and unchanged variants'. Every other enum in the client crates (CloseAfter, QuotaScope, ChatCreateInput, SpaceJoinInput, ReactionChange, FileNodeDownload, and others) is #[non_exhaustive].
Why breaking later: Adding a variant to an exhaustive pub enum is a semver-major change, because downstream exhaustive matches stop compiling. A future FileNode draft value for onExists, or a needs-action or registry value for RSVP, would force a major bump of the client crate. Adding #[non_exhaustive] after 0.4 is itself a breaking change, so it has to be done before 0.4.
Fix: Add #[non_exhaustive] to RsvpStatus and FileNodeOnExists. Optionally derive Copy/PartialEq/Eq/Hash on FileNodeOnExists to match its siblings; that part is additive and not required for 0.4.
